name: Remote Mining Asset — Hybrid Energy Pre-DD
description: Public-information desktop Pre-DD screen of a diesel-PV-BESS hybrid microgrid opportunity at a publicly documented Northern Territory gold mining project. Covers F1 approval delta, F2 site suitability, F3 microgrid boundary and F4 financeability readiness. Published as a demonstration of the method, not as a promotion of any particular asset. A screen of readiness, not a verdict on the project.
anonymisation_note: The asset is not named. The screen was built entirely from public records and was not commissioned by, endorsed by or verified with the project owner; publishing it under the owner's name would imply a relationship that does not exist. Source references that would identify the asset are marked 'withheld' in the evidence registry rather than silently dropped.

data_coverage.note: Public environmental-assessment documents date from 2020-2022; the Heliovulcan desktop screen was built June-July 2026 and republished in anonymised form in August 2026.

disclaimer: Independent public-information screen. Not commissioned by, endorsed by or verified with the project owner. Not legal, financial, tax, engineering, investment or lender due-diligence advice. All figures are indicative screening outputs and must be independently verified before any commercial decision.
